issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other 188,882.77 (prior year 11,173.57; next budget 30,000)
issues.issue: An unexplained 'Local Receipts: Other' line is 60% of the year's receipts (188,882.77 of 312,140.58 excluding transfers). It came in the same year as 198,444.66 of capital outlay and a 150,000 transfer to buy an ambulance, and p2 lists an 'Ambulance Donation Fund' reserve. It may be donations, grants or loan proceeds. The extractor recorded it as 'other' with a review note but added no decision_needed entry.
